title: The Glory of Longinus
english: The seraphim allow Longinus to glorify and the cherubim do not oppose him as he sings a hymn; he himself utters a sacred voice, a hymn-singer, a bearer of a trophy, mystical, and victorious: 'Truly this was the Son of God' (Matthew 27:54), which is before the ages, possesses, and will possess forever. He himself makes the ages old, yet he himself remains unchanged; for his kingdom is an eternal kingdom and his power will never be corrupted (Daniel 4:3), to him belongs the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
